posts.name: 26-world-retatrutide-reddit
posts.caption:
Thousands of Reddit users are taking retatrutide, a weight loss drug that is not approved yet. AI read their posts and found a surprise 🍽️

Not medical advice. Talk to a doctor before taking any weight loss drug.

Source: Sehgal, Tronieri, Rader, Ungar, Guntuku (University of Pennsylvania, Boston Children’s Hospital), “Self-Reported Adverse Effects Among Social Media Users Taking Nonapproved Retatrutide”, JAMA Network Open, 2026.
